test_get_filetypes: test the get_filetypes function to extract file extensions from a list of RepoSibling objects and group them by extension
test_get_filetypes_from_archive: test the get_filetypes_from_archives function to discover filetypes inside archive files like zip from a Hugging Face dataset
test_compute: test the DatasetFiletypesJobRunner compute method to retrieve and verify filetypes for a dataset on the Hugging Face Hub
test_get_filetypes_case_insensitive: test the get_filetypes function to normalize extensions case-insensitively so .txt, .tXt, and .TXT are grouped together
test_get_filetypes_compressed: test the get_filetypes function to detect compressed archives and report inner filetypes with compressed_in metadata
